title: A settle the person ticked at a check-in stays, even when a nearer line is read later (decision S2)
story: The same life as settle_later_stretch.json: set up Mon 1 Mar 2027, the bank holds 100,000, of which 40,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed); pay of about 250,000 (vary 0.3) on the 25th (moved earlier) starts the period; Free to spend is 60,000 a month; a dinner of 5,000 on Tue 23 Mar. On Wed 24 Mar the first statement's deposit of 200,000 (Mon 22 Mar) settles pay@2027-03-25. At the check-in that evening the bank shows 295,000, and the person ticks that settle: it was their pay, paid early (the check-in's `settled` names the line, written `ticked` here). On Mon 29 Mar a second statement shows 262,000 on Thu 25 Mar, nearer the pay's day; the ticked settle stays, so the period still starts on 22 Mar and the 262,000 is plain money in. Every amount is made up.

events.note: first statement: the pay, early; its settle ticked at the check-in of 24 Mar

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend for the period from Mon 22 Mar: the ticked settle stays) - 5,000 (dinner, Tue 23 Mar) = 55,000
asks.note: The 25 Mar line is nearer the pay's day, but the person ticked the earlier settle at a check-in, so it stays [S2].

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 295,000 (check of Wed 24 Mar) + 262,000 (money in, Thu 25 Mar) = 557,000
